$note: Documentation of the procedural cue set in src/client/audio/index.ts (not loaded at runtime). Every tonal cue is voiced in the world's scale; percussive cues take the world's noise colour.

voice.root: picked from A1..G#2 by the accent colour's hue
voice.scale: dorian when the palette is bright, minor pentatonic when it is dark
voice.timbre: glass (crystals/lanterns: sine bells with inharmonic partials) | electric (cables/ruined machinery: filtered square+saw, hiss) | deep (roots/spires/arches/monoliths: triangle + sub)
voice.brightness: palette luminance; opens filters and shortens tails

space: soft compressor + 170 ms dark feedback delay shared by every cue
bed: sanctuary: quiet detuned pad on root/fifth/third; expedition: darker root/fifth drone with a slow filter sweep (plus hiss in electric worlds); debrief: silence

cues.attack: melee swing: bandpass air whoosh sweeping down + low thump + noise-colour tick
cues.enemy_shot: enemy attack release: short zap from the 5th down to the root + high click
cues.hit: enemy damaged: dry noise-colour transient + 160→70 Hz body
cues.player_hit: you are hit: 95→38 Hz sub, dissonant square chirp, dark noise
cues.player_down: downed: slow hollow fall over two octaves with sub and rumble
cues.enemy_down: enemy dies: pitched crumble resolving into the root bell
cues.portal_open: saw swell up an octave under an ascending bell line
cues.room_enter: 48 Hz thud, root bell, fifth, dark noise — a door closing behind you
cues.room_clear: resolved rising triad ending on the root above
cues.revive: fifth then root with a bright breath
cues.lore: slow reverent bell pattern (root, fifth, third, root) with air; the only cue that takes its time
cues.anchor: the biggest moment: low saw swell, 40 Hz sub, four-bell chord, rising air
cues.terrain_blast: a canister goes up: hard noise-colour crack, 90->32 Hz sub, a short saw drop and a scatter of debris 90 ms later
cues.departure: the departure ritual: a 2.4 s saw and air swell arriving on the root as the flash lands, with root/fifth/root bells on the way
